verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an AI-powered accounting SaaS, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions model-training policies, data-use opt-outs, or a no-training commitment. The pack covers AI features, MCP access, exports and API sandboxes, none of which addresses whether customer data trains AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
